name: creator-os
description: Turns raw material into X posts that must pass the creator's own archive before review.

scripts.db:reset: rm -f data/creator-os.db data/creator-os.db-wal data/creator-os.db-shm && npm run seed
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:py
scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.test:py: cd agents && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
